name: k8s-deploy
description: Deployment rules for any starter, version 1.3.1: everything in 1.2.1 (a Deployment and Service per in-cluster node, the gateway's nginx config, the starter contract's environment, NetworkPolicies from the architecture's connects relationships, resource limits, liveness probes, no service-account tokens in pods, app.kubernetes.io labels, Nisshi 0.8.2, backing services rolled out one pod at a time) plus TLS between workloads joined by an HTTPS relationship: the gateway proxies to the service over HTTPS and checks its certificate, which an nginx sidecar serves on 8443 (Service port 443), issued by cert-manager from a self-signed CA in the namespace. 1.3.1 also gives objects valid Kubernetes names when a node's or relationship's unique-id is not one (as 1.2.2 does; use it rather than 1.3.0, which has the 1.2.1 naming). Needs cert-manager in the cluster: `yarn k8s:up` installs it.
